# Condr Grup

> Condr Grup S.R.L. is a construction contractor based in Vatra, Republic of Moldova, serving private and B2B clients.

## Core services
- Concrete pouring and platforms: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/beton-platforme.html
- Roads and exterior works: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/drumuri-amenajari.html
- Foundations and structures: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/fundatii-structuri.html
- Turnkey houses: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/case-la-cheie.html
- Renovations: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/renovari.html
- Demolition: https://condrgrup.md/servicii/demolari.html
